sources.title: src-tauri/src/worktrees.rs
sources.finding: Creates, renames, checks and removes Git worktrees and dedicated orchestration worktrees and branches from the desktop app.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/fs.rs
sources.finding: Uses gh to find the current branch pull request, create a pull request and return its URL, and list issues and pull requests for the inbox.

sources.title: src/features/inbox/model/ciRepair.ts
sources.finding: Inbox connects GitHub, Linear, Jira, GitLab and Azure DevOps (model files per source) and a CI repair flow starts a session from failing check evidence.

sources.title: src/features/source-control/model/diffComment.ts
sources.finding: Diff comments are composed on changed lines (DiffCommentComposer) and sent to the agent as feedback.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/mcp.rs
sources.finding: Reads and edits MCP server config for providers (including Claude Desktop config), adds one server at a time from JSON and discovers connections for a project; MCP use itself belongs to each provider CLI.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/skills.rs
sources.finding: Discovers skills from project and home skill roots by scope and source (max 5,000, frontmatter capped), with a disabled-path filter, and the UI offers a skill picker and slash commands.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/search.rs
sources.finding: Project text search via git grep with a file-scan fallback, cancellable by id.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/background_work.rs
sources.finding: Lowers CPU and disk priority of agent descendants and bounds optional indexing work with a four-permit semaphore.

sources.title: src/features/notifications/model/resourcePressure.ts
sources.finding: Samples CPU percent, memory pressure and stall share with high/low hysteresis to show a resource-pressure notice.

sources.title: src/features/notifications/model/dockBadge.ts
sources.finding: Pending approval or question count is pushed to the macOS Dock badge; useInputNotifications announces sessions that need input, and approvalToast builds approval and question notices.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/mobile_access.rs
sources.finding: A paired phone controls the workspace through the owning desktop window over a QUIC link; no arbitrary Tauri commands or direct database writes are exposed.

sources.title: host/server.ts
sources.finding: Remote host requires a 43-character bearer device credential checked against the store before and after reading a request body; credentials can be revoked.

sources.title: src/features/sessions/model/contextUsage.ts
sources.finding: Shows context used as a percentage and token counts per session (for example 176K of 256K tokens).

sources.title: src-tauri/src/rate_limits.rs
sources.finding: Reads the Claude account usage windows with the user own OAuth credential; similar usage readers exist for Devin and Pi; the UI shows account headroom and usage-limit resume.

sources.title: src/features/sessions/model/handoff.ts
sources.finding: Handoff and second-opinion cards move a conversation recap from one harness to another.

sources.title: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
sources.finding: Tauri 2 desktop bundle for all targets (macOS, Linux, Windows); main window minimum 800x520.

sources.title: MonoCode repository (bounded inspection)

No product implementation exists; hits were unrelated UI or test code. No outbound telemetry host appears in the source.
